reproducibility_conclusion: The benchmark infrastructure is reproducible; one low-budget CrossHair search outcome is intrinsically timing-sensitive under the evaluated execution environment.
scientific_interpretation: Exact repeated verdict stability is not claimed for the 0.5-second CrossHair search budget. That budget is empirically time-sensitive for one strict-core case. The frozen article value remains a valid record of the frozen execution, but should be interpreted as a budgeted search result, not as a deterministic property of the candidate. BIZPROOF formal evidence and Hypothesis outcomes are unaffected.

stable_components.CrossHair_2.0: 5/5 full replications reproduce 7/14; target unstable candidate additionally detected in 30/30 targeted trials
